walkthroughs.body_html: Salsa developed from Cuban music in 1960s New York. It runs on the clave — a five-stroke rhythm pattern. Samba drives Brazil's Carnival, with hundreds of percussionists.
Folk music is passed down by ear, not written. Each region has its own — Irish jigs, Scottish bagpipes, English sea shanties, Mexican mariachi.
Folk songs carried the news in pre-radio days — battles, weddings, harvests. Many famous pop singers (Bob Dylan, Ed Sheeran) draw from folk traditions.
